skill_name_rule_wf1.about: wants-fixes-v1 (content/helper-wants-fixes-v1.md). Four rules on top of skill_name_rule. Reference: dev/checks/hhcontent-wants-fixes/wants_fixes_step.py.
skill_name_rule_wf1.no_name_before_hyphen: A skill name never ends right before a hyphen: in a skill called "brag-slim" only brag-slim is named, not brag. (Builder's change in 9434be1, kept by Lead.)
skill_name_rule_wf1.longer_name_wins: When one skill name's match lies inside another's, only the longer counts: a skill called brag slim names brag-slim only. (Builder's change in 9434be1, kept by Lead.)
skill_name_rule_wf1.group_label_typed: A group's own label typed exactly (letters and digits only, any case: pictures and video) opens that group, as if picked. Only once the conversation is open (after the name and work questions). (Builder's change in 9434be1, kept by Lead.)
skill_name_rule_wf1.ordinary_names_rule: These skill names are ordinary words. After skill(s) for, such a name counts only when it is the last word of the message (is there a skill for maps). Followed by more words (skills for shop owners) it names no skill. The other patterns (the shop skill, a skill called shop) still count.
skill_name_rule_wf1.ordinary_names_judgement: hhcontent's judgement of which names a person would use as a plain word. Read from the 186 names: every name with no hyphen that is a common English word.
skill_name_rule_wf1.skill_for_unknown: Only in a question (route2 question_form). When the term step would explain the word skill, but the message asks for a skill for something (skill(s) for, or skill(s) that can / which can, then a word not in skill_for_not_after), and no row, skill or topic matched, the term line is not shown: the nearest group's N2 if one matches (I don't know that one, then its rows), else N1. is there a skill for knitting -> N1; is there a skill for editing photos -> N2 pics; what is a skill, what are skills for, is there a skill for me -> the term line. His words: if Helper doesn't know, it says so and doesn't make it up.
